انحلبوا (form VII)
# اِنْحَلَبُوا (inḥalabū) /in.ħa.la.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# اِنْحَلِبُوا (inḥalibū) /in.ħa.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
